services.desc: On Saturday, October 10, 2026, The Little Theatre of Walla Walla once again transforms Whitman’s Reid Center into a stage where secrets breathe and suspects sip cabernet with suspicious enthusiasm. This year, the mystery turns a literary page. Think towering tales, notorious authors, and threads of Walla Walla history stitched into the storyline like a well-placed clue. The setting remains as charming as ever. The crime, entirely new. - Exceptional local wines that swirl with character - A gourmet multi-course dinner worthy of a dramatic monologue - Two rounds of silent auction intrigue - A paddle raise where generosity takes center stage It is elegance with an alibi.
